$comment: The shape an APR specification must have, expressed as data so it can be checked rather than asserted. Each property records the specification it is borrowed from, so a reviewer can see what is being copied and why. Verified by scripts/check-spec-shape.py.

modelledOn.name: CommonMark
propertiesAdopted: one normative file, with no separately maintained corpus that could disagree with it
executable examples embedded in the specification and extracted into the test suite
an explicit statement of what is normative and what is illustrative

modelledOn.name: YAML 1.2.2
propertiesAdopted: separation of semantic model, serialization, and presentation
a terminology chapter that front-loads defined terms
syntax defined by production rather than by prose description

requiredSections.purpose: what this is and what defines it

structuralProperties.borrowedFrom: APR-specific; YAML and CommonMark cite stable numbers instead
structuralProperties.requirement: Every heading carries an explicit {#anchor}, because section numbers renumber and anchors do not.
The specification references no other document as normative. The format is fully described by this one file.
Examples marked apr-example are extracted into conformance vectors and executed.
Every executable example names the specification anchor it demonstrates.
Concrete syntax is defined by ABNF or by named reference to another specification, not by prose alone.
Two reference sections exist, and every cited designation appears in one of them.
Explanatory text is marked so that removing it cannot change the requirements.
The specification names which artifacts are derived from it and states that a disagreement is the derived artifact's defect.

structuralProperties.borrowedFrom: CommonMark example numbers; YAML production numbers
structuralProperties.requirement: Every normative clause carries an append-only [APR-AREA-NNN] identifier, so a test cites a rule rather than a section.

structuralProperties.borrowedFrom: APR-specific; neither CommonMark nor YAML has a schema
structuralProperties.requirement: Every member a specification table documents is declared in the schema with the same requiredness, and every member the schema declares is documented. Checked by scripts/check-schema-agrees.py.

knownShortfalls.requirement: The local model review asks generic coverage questions rather than checking against this manifest and the concept registry.
